chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Zutty never recorded with Louis except Dickerson and Chicago sessions
summary: They agree Zutty never made a full record date with Louis other than the Carroll Dickerson band, When You're Smiling, and the Chicago small-group sides such as Skip the Gutter and Knee Drops.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Yes, because I just loved to play with Louis.
Yes that must have been very heart breaking.
It was boy, we had a good band too.
Sure did have a good band.
We really did have a good band.
But you never got to record with Louis.
Oh yes. Well we made that 'When you're Smiling'. That was part of the band. And like those things I did with Louis in Chicago.
Oh the things you did, I'm talking about the Carroll Dickerson thing. You did a lot of stuff with Louis.
Well the thing about the Carroll Dickerson band records was that they were not well recorded. The balance is all screwed up.
